L44: # SV-833 (21SC60WQ_WQX-SV-833) site data in the Water Quality Portal

L47: 
L48: This river/stream site, maintained by the South Carolina Department of Environmental Services (identifier 21SC60WQ_WQX), has the name "SV-833" and has the identifier 21SC60WQ_WQX-SV-833. This site is in the watershed defined by the 8 digit 【19† Hydrologic Unit Code (HUC)†water.usgs.gov】03060101.
L49: This site is located in Anderson County County, South Carolina at 34.7047920000 degrees latitude and -82.6369660000 degrees longitude using the datum WGS84. No horizontal location accuracy metadata is available.
L50:
